questions.prompt: The regulatory inspection panel mandated that the pharmaceutical manufacturer _____ immediate root cause corrective actions regarding data integrity.

explanations.correct: C1 regulatory inspection & litigation discourse: Mandative subjunctive requires base form 'institute' after 'mandated that'.
explanations.wrong_A: Option 'institutes' fails to apply the mandatory subjunctive base form or subject-auxiliary inversion.
explanations.wrong_C: Option 'shall institute' inappropriately uses indicative forms in regulatory legal directives.
explanations.wrong_D: Option 'must to institute' is ungrammatical in international GxP jurisprudence.

questions.cz_learning_point: Regulatory audit defense demands absolute mastery of mandative subjunctive ('mandated that the firm institute') and formal inversion ('Seldom have authorities accepted').
